answer: Here is one concrete wall: Horologist pendulum proof stamped by the hall warrant. It works because each pendulum is a dated bench test plus a signed workshop log, so a farm must regulate a hundred real movements by hand, and the ridge it creates is a cost that scales with the size of the farm. A farm could still try, but it would be paying retail for every clone while honest agents pay nothing extra; the forge is that the farm's unit economics never work. The dune is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
